scripts.lint: npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:scripts:fix && npm run lint:php:fix
scripts.lint:scripts: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check
scripts.lint:scripts:fix: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write
scripts.theme:watch: echo 'This profile does not support watching for changes in the theme.'
scripts.module:watch: echo 'This profile does not support watching for changes in modules.'
scripts.test:deprecations: npm run test:deprecations:drupal && npm run test:deprecations:js
scripts.test:deprecations:js: echo 'This project does not define a deprecation check for javascript libraries.'
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run test:acceptance:php; npm run test:acceptance:js; npm run test:acceptance:css
scripts.test:functional: npm run test:functional:php && npm run test:functional:js
scripts.test:functional:php: echo 'This project does not define any functional php tests (e.g. codecept --config=testing/codeception run functional) '
scripts.test:functional:js: echo 'This project does not define any functional javascript tests'
scripts.test:api: npm run test:api:php && npm run test:api:js
scripts.test:api:php: echo 'This project does not define any API php tests (e.g. codecept --config=testing/codeception run api)'
scripts.test:api:js: echo 'This project does not define any API php tests.'
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:php && npm run test:unit:js
scripts.test:unit:php: echo 'This project does not define unit tests.'
scripts.test:unit:js: echo 'This project does not define unit tests.'
scripts.test:compatibility:js: echo 'This project does not define javascript compatibility tests'
